title: Arachnophobia
tagline: Eight legs, two fangs and an attitude.
about: A city doctor with a fear of spiders moves his family to a country town just as a deadly spider from Venezuela starts a colony in his barn.
cue: Pour the red when Ross falls through the floor into his wine cellar.

    To StartVenezuelan black bean arepasIt came from a tepui in Venezuela. Corn cakes with black beans and queso fresco.How to make it250g pre-cooked white cornmeal (masarepa)375ml warm water1 tbsp olive oil400g tin black beans, drained1 small brown onion, diced1 garlic clove, crushed1 tsp ground cumin120g queso fresco or feta, crumbled1 avocado, sliced1 limeMix the masarepa with the warm water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest for 5 minutes.Fry the onion, garlic and cumin in the oil, add the beans and a splash of water and mash roughly.Shape the dough into 8 small patties and cook on an oiled griddle until crusted on both sides.Split the arepas and stuff with beans, cheese, avocado and a squeeze of lime.Dr. Death's devilled eggsRoss gets nicknamed Doctor Death. Smoky paprika yolks and crisp shallots.How to make it8 eggs3 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp white wine vinegar1 tsp smoked paprika3 tbsp fried shallots1 small bunch chives, snippedLower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water and peel.Halve them, mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and half the paprika and season well.Pipe the yolk back into the whites.Dust with the rest of the paprika and top with fried shallots and chives.Popcorn, checked twiceLook in the bowl before you reach in.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsCountry doctor's chicken pot pieThe old town doctor won't retire. Creamy chicken-and-leek puff pastry pie.How to make it700g chicken thigh fillets, diced40g butter2 leeks, sliced2 carrots, diced2 celery sticks, diced3 tbsp plain flour500ml chicken stock125ml pouring cream1 tbsp thyme leaves1 cup frozen peas2 sheets of puff pastry1 egg, beatenBrown the chicken in half the butter and set aside.Soften the leeks, carrots and celery in the rest of the butter, then stir in the flour for a minute.Whisk in the stock and cream, add the chicken and thyme and simmer until thick, then stir in the peas.Spoon into a pie dish, lay the pastry over, crimp the edges, brush with egg and cut a steam hole.Bake at 200°C until the pastry is puffed and deep golden.San Francisco cioppinoThey left San Francisco for this. Garlicky tomato seafood stew.How to make it2 tbsp olive oil1 brown onion, diced1 fennel bulb, sliced4 garlic cloves, sliced1 tsp chilli flakes800g tinned crushed tomatoes500ml fish stock400g firm white fish fillets, in chunks300g green prawns, peeled500g mussels, cleaned1 handful parsley, chopped1 sourdough loafSoften the onion, fennel and garlic in the oil with the chilli.Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer until rich.Add the fish and mussels, cover for 3 minutes, then add the prawns until pink and the mussels open.Scatter with parsley and serve with thick slices of grilled sourdough.Something SweetSpun sugar web chocolate tartRoss takes on the general in the cellar. Dark chocolate ganache under a sugar web.How to make it1 sheet shortcrust pastry300ml pouring cream250g dark chocolate, chopped30g butter1/4 tsp sea salt flakes150g caster sugarLine a 22cm tart tin with the pastry, fill with baking paper and rice and blind bake at 190°C, then bake uncovered until golden.Bring the cream to a simmer, pour it over the chocolate and butter, stir until glossy and add the salt.Pour into the cooled case and chill until set.Melt the sugar in a dry pan to a pale caramel, then flick thin threads from a fork over a rolling pin to make a web.Lay the sugar web over the tart just before serving.To DrinkThe Chateau red sangriaHe throws his good wine at the spider. Cabernet, orange, brandy and soda.How to make it1 x 750ml bottle cabernet sauvignon60ml brandy2 oranges, sliced1 red apple, diced2 tbsp caster sugar300ml soda water2 cups ice cubesStir the wine, brandy, sugar and fruit together in a jug and chill.Add ice and soda water and pour.Cold milk, cereal box checkedSheriff Lloyd found a spider in his cereal.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
